question: SARFAESI Act in India is related to which of the following sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Financial sector**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **SARFAESI Act** stands for the **Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets and Enforcement of Security Interest Act**, which was enacted in the year **2002**.
 
• It is a crucial piece of legislation in India designed to help **Banks** and **Financial Institutions** recover their **Non-Performing Assets (NPAs)** more efficiently.
 
• The primary objective of the act is to allow **secured creditors** to take possession of collateral and sell or lease it to recover outstanding debts without the mandatory intervention of a **Civil Court** or **Tribunal**.
 
• Before this act, lenders had to follow lengthy legal procedures under the **Recovery of Debts Due to Banks and Financial Institutions (RDDBFI) Act, 1993**, which often delayed recovery for years.
